en: The front of the postcard depicts a historic, colorized scene of a landscaped park area with elegant garden buildings and people dressed in late 19th or early 20th-century attire. Prominently, there is a classic European pavilion and a villa-style building surrounded by lush greenery. The bottom of the image is labeled with 'BAD PYRMONT Helenenquelle.' The reverse side is titled 'TUCK'S POSTKARTE' and bears the logos and imprints of the renowned postcard publisher Raphael Tuck & Sons, as well as a museum stamp.
